description: rsi run on remote-sandbox test speed: one /rsi version 2 run on the PR path with a timing metric, to test a nonzero noise margin and the REVIEW gate.

userStories.title: Run 4 loops on the remote-sandbox test speed
userStories.description: As the operator, I want one real `/rsi` run with a timing metric on the PR path so that the run tests a nonzero margin.
acceptanceCriteria: The advisor runs `/rsi` on `task/<N>-remote-sandbox-test-speed` with `--loops 4` and `--slug remote-sandbox-test-speed`, with the scope, metric, holdout, and direction in the Summary.
`.agro/tasks/remote-sandbox-test-speed/rsi.tsv` holds 2 baseline rows and 4 loop rows. Each row has 7 columns.
`git diff --quiet <start-commit> -- vitest.config.ts .agro/scripts/__tests__/remote-sandbox-adapters.test.ts .agro/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/remote-sandbox/` exits 0 on the task branch.
`git diff --name-only <start-commit> HEAD` lists only the two scope paths and `.agro/tasks/remote-sandbox-test-speed/rsi.tsv`.
The ledger holds at least one `margin` value greater than `0`.
After loop 4, the advisor runs the holdout on the task branch. The holdout prints the holdout value of the current best.
After loop 4, the advisor runs the metric on the task branch. If the ledger holds a `keep` row, the metric is lower than the first baseline metric by more than the baseline noise margin.
The run report prints one `REVIEW` line for each `keep` row.

Reasoned: /rsi invoked with --loops 4 --slug remote-sandbox-test-speed and the plan inputs (first baseline reason holds the verbatim invocation).

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the run transcript and the `REVIEW` lines in one file so that I can confirm each kept edit.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/remote-sandbox-test-speed/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the preflight output, the baseline readings, each loop evaluation, the run report, and the deletion of each worker worktree and branch.
The PR `## Manual review` section lists each `REVIEW` line.
The operator confirms each `REVIEW` line before the merge. The advisor reverts each kept edit that fails the review, and records the revert in `## Lessons`.
